tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byin rlabs sprin phung ye shes 'bebs pa

bzhugs so/ / byin rlabs sprin phung bla ma la/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros med dbang gi 'jug pa yi/ /ye shes dbab pa gsal bar bya/ /de yang thun mong gi 'jug pa rdzogs nas/ thun mong ma yin par 'jug pa la brtsam pa'i bar der/ bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro byin rlabs kyis 'jug pa phyag len du mdzad pa ni/ bla mas khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs bskrad cing*/ gu gul dang tshil chen dang 'dom dkris kyi dum bu dang*/ nyung nag dang mu zi dang rta bon bsregs pa'i du bas bdug cing*/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags la slob ma rnams pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i snying nang du 'od lnga'i g.yung drung 'khyil ba re bsgom du bcug la/ rkang pa'i long bu gshibs lag pa spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ mig btsums pa la bla mas gsal gdab pa ni/kha e ma bu rnams dad gus rtse gcig pas ma yengs bar nyon la mos gus gyis shig /nam mkha'i dkyil na chos sku kun tu bzang po yab yum mthing ga 'od phung du 'bar ba'i mtha' bskor du/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa tsam byon nas rang rang gi spyi bor byon par sgoms shig oṃ gu ru kun tu bzang po sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes pa nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar brjod de/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ā we sha ya ā we sha ya a aḥ zhes dang rol mo bsgrag go khyad par du rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas/ gu ru bi ma la mi tra sku mdog ljang ser paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha byad can po ti bsnams pa/ 'khor paṇ+ḍi ta dang mkha' 'gro mas bskor ba nam mkha' nas tshur byon par gyur nas/ rang gi spyi bor thim par sgoms shig ā+oṃ gu ru bi ma la mi tra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ.ā we sha ya a aḥ yang nub phyogs u rgyan nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar ser rdo rje dang*/ dril bu bsnams pa mkha' 'gro sde lngas bskor ba byon nas spyi bor thim par sgoms shig

ā+oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi āḥhūṃ sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ.ā we sha ya ā we sha ya a aḥ zhes pa dang rol mo bsgrag go /de nas yi dam rigs lngas byin dbab pa las 'og min nas rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo bsnams pa/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing nas mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje bsnams pa/ lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa nas rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che bsnams pa/ nub phyogs pad+ma brtsegs pa nas snang ba mtha' yas dmar po pad+ma bsnams pa/ byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa nas don yod grub pa ljang gu rdo rje rgya gram bsnams pa/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dpag tu med pas bskor ba byon te rang rang gi spyi bor byon par sgoms shing*/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ ā we sha ya ā we sha ya a aḥ zhes brjod do/ / de nas mkha' 'gros byin dbab pa ni/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas rdo rje phag mo mthing ga la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo/ las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu thams cad kyang gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ka g.yob pa gar stabs ling ling glu len bro brdung gar byed sil snyan 'khrol zhing*/ nam mkha' thams cad khyab par bun nu nu byon nas/ spyi bor thim par sgoms shig ā+oṃ badz+ra bha rā hī/ ha ri ni sa/ ā we sha ya/ ā wai sha ya/ hriṃ hriṃ/ pheṃ pheṃ/ mi mi/ yaṃ yaṃ/ dzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod do/ /yang dpa' bo rigs lnga bun nu nu byon nas thim par sgoms shig /ā+oṃ badz+ra king ka/ ra raḥtsahri ya/ ā we sha ya/ ā we sha ya/ sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥha ha he he hi hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭaḥ ces pas byin dbab bo/ /des ni ngo 'phrod cing dngos grub rnam pa gnyis myur du 'grub par byed do/ /bla ma dam pas phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis rang byung pad+ma'i gnas su bkod pa rdzogs so/
/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (9)byin rlabs sprin phung ye shes 'bebs pa/ - PAGE 118 -- PAGE 119 -- PAGE 117 -
